text: Because human brains simplify complex systems for coherence while complex adaptive systems evolve through self-organizing group behavior, decentralizing the interaction of DAO developers would support random developer interaction and make developer perspectives on software development more diverse.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization and Feedback Effects (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808852
